g.title: MarieRank3Convo2 begins.
g.text: MarieRank3Convo2 begins.

g.title: j3102612293
g.text: Boolean MarieLyonAvailable is now true.

g.title: j369807617
g.text: Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete

g.title: j2283929642
g.text: I hope you do not think me infirme... but I get the strangest sensation sometimes as though I have done this before ?

g.title: j369807617->j2283929642
g.text: true

g.title: j1668831657
g.text: Check boolean MarieFamily1

g.title: j369807617->j1668831657
g.text: false

g.title: j3715427701
g.text: Had these conversations... met these people... though it is impossible, non ?

g.title: j3936554108
g.text: Will you tell me more of le Cardinal's famille ? I am fascinated to know of his past.

g.title: j1668831657->j3936554108
g.text: true

g.title: j2347049738
g.text: Will you tell me of le Cardinal's famille ? I am fascinated to know of his past.

g.title: j1668831657->j2347049738
g.text: false

g.title: j3402498936
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3841711581
g.text: I'll tell you all I know, but I'm afraid I don't know as much as you might think.

g.title: j3195270117
g.text: Oh. Sure, but... wouldn't Loid be the better person to talk to?

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j1930388968
g.text: We call it déjà vu. Must be because of the sérum and the time travel. C'est la vie !

g.title: j3808420072
g.text: Whatever you can tell me, I shall cherish. Promis !

g.title: j1117745356
g.text: Speaking of le Cardinal... seems to hurt Monsieur Loid quite deeply. I do not like to do so overmuch.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j1031135382
g.text: Especially as I do it avec une certaine joie, which no one else seems to do.

g.title: j2627601836
g.text: Who do you want to know about?

g.title: j3647554769
g.text: Well, there's Mother, Father, Son, Daughter, and Grandmother upstairs.

g.title: j2226009847
g.text: Settle one thing first, will you ? The devil laughs at me every time I ask, as if it is a private joke. Grand-mère. Grandmother.

g.title: j18688222
g.text: That is not le Cardinal's wife, non ?

g.title: j915074653
g.text: No, that's Father's mother. Mother's mother-in-law.

g.title: j2418867625
g.text: Je... vois. And... why do they not go by their names ? Ne serait-ce pas plus simple ?

g.title: j1109873819
g.text: Do you want the long story?

g.title: j1291327540
g.text: I'll give you the short of it.

g.title: j434976151
g.text: Oui ! I have nowhere else to be for a little while.

g.title: j10244409
g.text: The family upstairs was trapped here when the Orokin Empire collapsed. Son, Entrati's grandson, let the Infestation in.

g.title: j3708105753
g.text: Well, we are on a moon called Deimos. And a biological bomb was detonated here, long ago, in a desperate attempt to repel the Sentients.

g.title: j2693509538
g.text: Par Sol ! On purpose ?

g.title: j4022640158
g.text: The ones the Orokin were at war with, long ago ? The ones we see in the Dark Refractory with the devil, oui ?

g.title: j2753523360
g.text: Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank(syndicate=EntratiSyndicate, syndicateRank=5)

g.title: j2182736274
g.text: Yes. They tried to harness the Infestation to fight the Sentients. But Deimos became overrun. They locked themselves in the Necralisk - which is above us - for shelter.

g.title: j1237448132
g.text: No, I think it was an accident. I think he means well.

g.title: j2753523360->j1237448132
g.text: true

g.title: j746353514
g.text: I don't know the truth yet, but I'll reserve judgement until I know more.

g.title: j2753523360->j746353514
g.text: true

g.title: j2753523360->j746353514
g.text: false

g.title: j768470940
g.text: I don't know the truth yet, but he's arrogant, I can tell you that much.

g.title: j2753523360->j768470940
g.text: false

g.title: j2635482855
g.text: Son, Entrati's Grandson, however, was intent on trying to preserve and study the infested animals.

g.title: j3889035880
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1726125548
g.text: For shame. I hope that is not true, for his sake and ours. Please continue.

g.title: j3430174897
g.text: Oh, Sol... did he mean well ?

g.title: j322530531
g.text: Quite kind of you. Continuez, s'il vous plaît.

g.title: j3507898586
g.text: Well, trapped in the Necralisk, and consumed by grief and with no Orokin Empire to rescue them, and now with the Infestation leaking in...

g.title: j2755410679
g.text: Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank(syndicate=EntratiSyndicate, syndicateRank=5)

g.title: j994756743
g.text: They turned on each other. Ripped each other apart from the inside out. And the Infestation did the rest. Taking their very names from them.

g.title: j613008289
g.text: Yes, I believe he did. I think he honestly cares about the creatures.

g.title: j2755410679->j613008289
g.text: true

g.title: j2755410679->j613008289
g.text: false

g.title: j429626999
g.text: Sadly, it didn't matter, the reckless damage was done.

g.title: j2755410679->j429626999
g.text: true

g.title: j2755410679->j429626999
g.text: false

g.title: j1097724066
g.text: No, it was arrogance that inspired him. Even if he claims it was an accident.

g.title: j2755410679->j1097724066
g.text: true

g.title: j2693551455
g.text: I don't know the truth yet, but he's arrogant, I can tell you that much.

g.title: j2755410679->j2693551455
g.text: false

g.title: j58025733
g.text: It is the ultimate form of cruelty, to be absent of a name...

g.title: j1837585791
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j132266698
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j482800561
g.text: Boolean MarieFamily2 is now true.

g.title: j3506244908
g.text: I wonder what he would make of the Cavia... such a pity he cannot meet them...

g.title: j873395152
g.text: If only the purity of one's intentions were all that mattered, the world would be a beautiful place, non ? C'est la vie.

g.title: j3320293913
g.text: Unless you give it away, like Grandmother.

g.title: j1844535698
g.text: It's honestly not so bad, you get used to it.

g.title: j460586221
g.text: Animals don't have names, and they seem perfectly happy. We give them names simply for our own sake.

g.title: j2812987738
g.text: I'm smiling at the idea. But I don't think it'd be wise.

g.title: j1550957560
g.text: I hope that'll happen someday. I really do.

g.title: j1763410179
g.text: Et ensuite ?

g.title: j417863788
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1049162010
g.text: Aaah ! Quelle horreur ! I did not mean ! Oh, I am mortified ! I am so sorry, forgive me, I did not mean - oh, I am a fool !

g.title: j3129624437
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2467828378
g.text: And why not ?

g.title: j3948333923
g.text: Add 1 to Family counter

g.title: j3032662219
g.text: Now she sounds like a lady I would adore to meet...

g.title: j2473582878
g.text: How will you make it up to me?

g.title: j1525870475
g.text: It's all right, I'm only teasing. I'm not upset.

g.title: j3424203819
g.text: That is quite true ! I never thought of it that way. And you could choose your own. How freeing, in its own sense.

g.title: j1542977062
g.text: I'm afraid one half will see the other half as "the other family."

g.title: j4256342580
g.text: The situation upstairs is... fragile on the best of days. I don't want to upset them.

g.title: j1827137725
g.text: Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank(syndicate=EntratiSyndicate, syndicateRank=5)

g.title: j1176095245
g.text: This has been such a wonderful conversation, but I fear it is my turn to serve luncheon. Monsieur Loid is teaching me how to properly serve tea in his fashion !

g.title: j3108264214
g.text: Maintenant, vous parlez aussi mal que le diable. No, I will not fall for your tricks.

g.title: j2401401464
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3606432815
g.text: Add 1 to Family counter

g.title: j2981857401
g.text: You would be surprised how resilient the soul is. And those that surround me now are so very old, so very tempered by time.

g.title: j2174375645
g.text: It can be done. Easier, perhaps than you think. We must just think of how.

g.title: j1827137725->j2174375645
g.text: true

g.title: j490239373
g.text: Oui ? And how goes you or your minuscule copie's work with the famille above ?

g.title: j1827137725->j490239373
g.text: false

g.title: j1443376586
g.text: Oh, loué soit Sol ! But it does raise the question... Do you know where you received your moniker ? "Le Drifter ?"

g.title: j1663905866
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2429322934
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3582671429
g.text: We just have to be careful. I'm afraid one half will see the other half as "the other family."

g.title: j1958828849
g.text: Slowly. Carefully. I'm afraid one half will see the other half as the "other family."

g.title: j1639404312
g.text: I hope I picked it myself.

g.title: j779125076
g.text: I don't remember, honestly.

g.title: j1870193259
g.text: Oh... Par Sol, I think you may have solved it !

g.title: j1858114606
g.text: You have surprised them many times. Let them surprise you this once.

g.title: j3776600825
g.text: How freeing would that be ! To pick one's own name. In the Cathédrale, I could not even pick my own clothes. Hah !

g.title: j408028419
g.text: So many mystères, you bring with you !

g.title: j1104432155
g.text: Boolean MarieFamilyOther is now true.

g.title: j3687797841
g.text: But please, please, s'il vous plaît, continue your story. Your little wolf Marie must know her quarry before she properly hunts, non ?

g.title: j1572601559
g.text: I am beside myself with excitement - je suis assise ici, remuant sur ma chaise !

g.title: j1526043547
g.text: Where was I?

g.title: j546542382
g.text: That was a little wicked of you, wasn't it?

g.title: j1122953412
g.text: Perhaps I wish you would hunt me...

g.title: j3285312919
g.text: Son had invited the Animaux Infestés too close.

g.title: j804003385
g.text: Peut-être ! But where is the harm in a little wickedness in the name of good, hm ?

g.title: j155417688
g.text: Boolean DrifterMarie is now true.

g.title: j2735353868
g.text: Right... Anyway, back to the story.

g.title: j2457788814
g.text: Don't take it the wrong way. I enjoyed it.

g.title: j3166551294
g.text: You are going to ruin me ! I just squeaked audibly and Monsieur Loid asked if I was all right. I had to lie and say that I saw a mouse, only for him to tell me that we have no mice in this time !

g.title: j2948408009
g.text: Hah ! I thought you might. Now, enough with your silliness, and back to your story. Son had invited the Animaux Infestés too close, oui ?

g.title: j2616478708
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2189726668
g.text: Quelle méchanceté, tu es terrible ! Je te déteste et tu me fais rougir maintenant !

g.title: j2181748506
g.text: Are you mad at me?

g.title: j2157375836
g.text: Non ! Just continue your story !
